# Dating Dashboard Design Skill for Muse

A design skill that turns a dating or matchmaking brief into a single-screen consumer dashboard styled like a Sunday-paper dating column rendered as software: a top ticker strip, a 220–260px left-rail navigation (today / you / archive), a 3×3 KPI grid with oversized serif numerals, a 30-day mutual-matches bar chart, and a 12-week match-rate trend panel — editorial typography, creamy off-white background, a single restrained accent, and wry observational copy. It writes one self-contained HTML document with inline CSS and SVG charts, enforces a strict self-check (no swipe deck, no hearts, no fire emoji), and emits the result as an artifact you can preview directly. Includes a design-system contract and an example prompt. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: this is a design template, not a functioning dating app — it produces a polished visual prototype with plausible sample data, part of the open-design template collection; real matching logic is on you. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
